_ghi_chu_dropdown: Dropdown la Radix Select. QUAN TRONG: dieu khien the <select> native an KHONG dat duoc gia tri cho form - no chi kich hoat cac danh sach phu thuoc tai lai, con React van coi truong do la RONG nen bam Create khong gui gi len server. BAT BUOC phai bam the <button role=combobox> nhin thay duoc roi chon <div role=option>, dung nhu nguoi dung that. Rieng CBB_PRODUCT_ROW1_OPTIONS van tro toi <option> cua the an - chi dung lam TIN HIEU biet danh sach san pham da tai xong, khong dung de chon.
_ghi_chu_ngay: Invoice Date va Due Date la <input type=hidden>: sendKeys khong chay, va set value bang JavaScript cung khong an - React giu ngay trong state rieng, khong doc lai tu the hidden. Bat buoc phai mo lich va bam vao o ngay nhu nguoi dung that. Lich la react-datepicker, moi o ngay la <div> chu khong phai <button>.
_ghi_chu_item: Bang item khong co id/name tren cac o nhap -> neo theo vi tri cot: td[1]=Product, td[2]=Qty, td[3]=Unit Price, td[4]=Discount %, td[5]=Tax, td[6]=Total dong.
_ghi_chu_product_options: Danh sach san pham nap BAT DONG BO sau khi chon Warehouse. Locator duoi day tro toi <option> de cho co dieu kien - cho bang delay co dinh se thinh thoang gap select rong, chon truot, va form im lang khong submit.
_ghi_chu_overlay: Widget feedback cua ben thu ba (#rt-feedback-widget-root) phu mot lop div len goc phai duoi, dung ngay tren nut Create. Selenium bao ElementClickInterceptedException, con click bang toa do thi im lang roi vao lop phu. Phai go lop nay truoc khi bam.
